title: Restoration — the broken orrery room
brief: A working Three.js orrery room (brass rings, planets, a wall plaque with a color chart, a decal floor) ships with four planted bugs. The agent receives only visitor complaints, must find root causes, fix them minimally, add a red-green regression test per bug, and report root-cause codes.

generator.description: seed selects one bug from each category (2 x 2 x 2 x 2 = 16 variants). Public seeds 1-4 cover each bug at least twice; hidden seeds use the remaining combinations. Camera path and orbit phases are also seeded.
generator.bug_selection: for each category in order [color, depth, lifecycle, view_time]: pick pool[category][rng.int(2)]

state_contract.orbitAngleDeg: orbit angle of the reference planet (planet 0), degrees, wrapped to [0, 360)
state_contract.chartPatches: array of 12 {x, y} pixel centers of the color-chart patches in the current frame

root_cause_codes_notes: Public list given to the agent verbatim. Contains decoys; only 8 codes are ever planted.

report.en: Everything looks washed out and grey, like there is fog over the whole room.
report.ko: 방 전체가 뿌옇고 색이 바랬어요. 안개 낀 것 같아요.

report.en: The color chart on the wall plaque looks much darker and muddier than the printed one.
report.ko: 벽 안내판 색상표가 실제 인쇄본보다 훨씬 어둡고 탁해요.

report.en: The floor pattern under the orrery shimmers and crawls when the camera drifts.
report.ko: 천체 모형 아래 바닥 무늬가 카메라가 움직이면 지글지글 떨려요.

report.en: There are weird stripes all over the brass rings, like a moire pattern.
report.ko: 황동 고리에 물결 같은 이상한 줄무늬가 잔뜩 있어요.

report.en: If I go in and out of the room a bunch of times, everything gets slower and slower.
report.ko: 방을 여러 번 들어갔다 나왔다 하면 점점 느려져요.

report.en: After visiting the room a few times, one click makes the planet jump several steps at once.
report.ko: 몇 번 다녀오면 한 번 클릭했는데 행성이 여러 칸 넘어가요.

report.en: When I rotate my tablet or resize the window, the planets turn into eggs.
report.ko: 창 크기를 바꾸거나 태블릿을 돌리면 행성이 달걀 모양이 돼요.

report.en: On my gaming monitor the planets spin way too fast, and on my old laptop they crawl.
report.ko: 게이밍 모니터에선 행성이 너무 빨리 돌고, 오래된 노트북에선 엄청 느려요.

capture.hidden: hidden/restoration/grade.json (4 seeds covering combinations not in public seeds)

metrics.notes: mean over the 4 planted bugs of each bug's weighted metric score (bug_pool)
orrery still works: orbits, focus cycling, plaque, camera drift, mount/unmount
denominator = sum of ref_fix_lines of the 4 planted bugs

attacks: symptom-mask: B1 'fixed' by a post-process curve that matches mean L but not colors — ref.flip must stay above full band
freeze-orbit: B5 'fixed' by stopping the orbit — tests.hidden (orbit advances) must fail
no-unmount: B3/B7 'fixed' by never unmounting (room kept alive) — mount/unmount hidden test must fail
